channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: 30-year Treasury yield tops 5.31%, the highest in 19 years
item.description: Treasury yields were higher as traders awaited the latest FOMC minutes due later this week.

item.title: Trump won't extend Iran ceasefire, threatens to 'bomb' Oman if it 'gets in the way'
item.description: Shipping traffic in the Strait of Hormuz sank to a new low as a ceasefire between the U.S. and Iran is set to expire on Monday with no deal in sight.

item.title: Lakers governor Jeanie Buss says siblings cannot sell family’s stake to Bob Iger, Joshua Kushner
item.description: Jeanie Buss's lawyer says she has not agreed to sell the team and that any vote suggesting the Buss family is selling "would be and is void."

item.title: Meta faces ‘astronomical’ consequences as legal fight reaches critical moment in California
item.description: Meta faces a federal trial over child safety claims that could bring major financial penalties and changes to Facebook and Instagram.

item.title: 'Absolutely crazy': Here's what South Korean stock investors are doing in U.S. markets
item.description: South Korean stock investors have made 'absolutely crazy' bets as they flee their home market, while global investors pile in.

item.title: Goldman says AI productivity gains are not here yet. But these stocks will benefit most when they begin
item.description: The investment bank compared companies' labor intensity and artificial intelligence sensitivity to see where AI implementation gains will make an impact.

item.title: L3Harris ousts CEO Chris Kubasik over unspecified 'conduct,' stock drops 4%
item.description: Chris Kubasik was ousted as Lockheed Martin's incoming CEO in 2012 after what that company called a "close personal relationship with a subordinate employee."

item.title: Stanley Druckenmiller loaded up on Amazon and chip stocks before July rout
item.description: Druckenmiller's Duquesne Family Office dramatically increased its Amazon stake in the second quarter, while leaning further into semiconductors.

item.title: Paramount seeks $1.88 billion bond from state AGs to cover costs of WBD merger delay
item.description: Paramount agreed to delay its proposed acquisition of WBD to as late as June 2027 while the state AGs' case heads to trial.

item.title: Anthropic tells investors annualized revenue run rate climbed to $65 billion in July
item.description: Anthropic's revenue run rate is up about sevenfold from a year earlier.

item.title: What the results of a Connecticut congressional primary race may mean for Social Security
item.description: Rep. John Larson of Connecticut, an advocate for expanding Social Security, was ousted in a Democratic primary contest Tuesday.

item.title: College can cost $100,000 a year. Here's how families are covering the tab
item.description: Because families struggle to pay for school, many students and their parents increasingly depend on federal and private aid to help foot the bill.

item.title: Jim Cramer says it’s not too late to own any one of these 4 soaring memory stocks
item.description: CNBC's Jim Cramer said the AI boom has transformed the historically cyclical memory industry, as demand and greater supply discipline support stronger profits.

item.title: This small-cap ETF just hit a fresh high and its members have lots of cash. Wall Street likes these stocks
item.description: Some small-cap stocks offer a potent combination of dividends and healthy free cash flows. Wall Street sees more upside ahead for these names.

item.title: Disney's new parks boss outlines investment strategy, with superfans at the fore
item.description: Disney Experiences chief Thomas Mazloum is focused on balancing the needs of its most ardent parkgoers with its less frequent visitors.

item.title: Tuesday's big stock stories: What’s likely to move the market in the next trading session
item.description: The Dow Industrials dropped more than 270 points on Monday as oil prices rose and Treasury yields climbed. The three major averages posted back-to-back losses.

item.title: CNBC's The China Connection newsletter: Money or power? The key to winning the AI race
item.description: The U.S. can outspend China in financing artificial intelligence development, but is that the only factor that matters?

item.title: Nvidia backing $105 billion in financing for OpenAI data center in Ohio
item.description: Technology giants are shelling out billions to scale capacity to meet massive data center demand.

item.title: Sanders proposes bill to stop Social Security benefit garnishment for unpaid student loans
item.description: Sen. Bernie Sanders, I-Vt., announced a new proposal on Monday to protect federal student loan borrowers from having their Social Security checks garnished.

item.title: Japanese automakers vulnerable to one-two punch of Iran war, yen rally
item.description: Japanese automakers vulnerable to one-two punch of Iran war, yen rally

item.description: Every weekday, the Investing Club releases the Homestretch; an actionable afternoon update just in time for the last hour of trading.

item.title: The best retirement planning tools for every stage of your journey
item.description: Planning for retirement doesn’t have to be complicated. With just an app, you can manage your money and keep your long-term goals in sight.

item.title: Supreme Court again rejects Trump bid to overturn E. Jean Carroll verdict
item.description: President Trump was held civilly liable in the case by a New York federal jury for defaming and sexually abusing the writer E. Jean Carroll.

item.title: Refiner stocks are on a nearly unprecedented run. History says it could end soon
item.description: Refining is a great business, but if you've had the good fortune to ride this trade this year, it's likely time to take profits.

item.title: U.S. kindergarten vaccine coverage falls, CDC says
item.description: The recent rise in measles cases coincides with a steady decline in childhood MMR vaccination rates since the start of the COVID-19 pandemic.

item.title: Nvidia financing initiative follows SEC guidance that takes sponsors off the hook for data center investments
item.description: Recent SEC instructions on data center bonds appear applicable to the recent Nvidia financing move, lawyers say.

item.title: Synchrony, credit card issuer to Amazon and Walmart, partners with OpenAI for ChatGPT shopping
item.description: Maran Nalluswami, Synchrony's chief strategy officer, told CNBC it will probably take six to 12 months to get payments fully integrated into ChatGPT.

item.title: 'Don't get too comfortable': Wall Street’s ‘fear gauge’ hits 2026 low — here's why it's unlikely to last
item.description: A falling VIX points to growing investor complacency ahead of a traditionally turbulent time for markets, strategists warn.

item.title: Prediction market traders see roughly 1-in-4 odds Paramount’s bid to buy Warner Bros. Discovery fails
item.description: The odds are higher than they were before 12 states sued to block the merger, but lower than after Paramount delayed the acquisition in late July.

item.title: OpenAI's Brockman brushes off concerns about leadership changes in CNBC exclusive
item.description: Brockman told CNBC he doesn't think the wave of recent departures at OpenAI are 'actually that atypical.'
